item.title: Missouri Capitol dome to glow teal, purple for National 988 Day, Suicide Prevention Month
item.description: The state capitol dome will shine teal and purple in recognition of National 988 Day and Suicide Prevention Awareness Month beginning Tuesday evening.

item.title: Paul Wagner picked as new Columbia Board of Education member
item.description:
COLUMBIA, Mo. (KMIZ) The Columbia Board of Education unanimously picked Paul Wagner to become its newest member during its Thursday meeting. Five people filed to hold the seat formerly held by  Jeanne Snodgrass, who stepped down in July because she is moving.  The other finalist was Erica Perry. Wagner will be sworn in on Monday, Sept.
